info.description: Generic placeholder block for a position within a Section's Blocks zone, for embedding a frontend component that doesn't exist yet (or is too app-specific to warrant its own CMS schema). Editors set a componentKey + freeform config now; studio-vr looks componentKey up in src/course/customEmbedRegistry.js and renders whatever's registered there, so new embed types ship as a frontend-only change — no CMS migration needed.

componentKey.description: Identifies which frontend component to mount, e.g. "before-after-slider". Free text, matching the pattern of course.interactive-activity's `kind` — studio-vr's registry maps this string to a real React component once one is built.

title.description: Optional heading/label passed through to the embedded component (and shown by the "not built yet" placeholder before one is registered).

enabled.description: Whether this embed is live. When off, studio-vr shows a disabled placeholder instead of mounting the component.

config.description: Arbitrary configuration handed to the embedded component as props once one is registered for componentKey. Shape is whatever that component expects — intentionally not validated by this schema.

layout.description: Optional side-by-side placement for this block relative to the next one in the Section's Blocks list — see course.block-layout's own description and STRAPI_SCHEMA_NOTES.md's "Side-by-side block layout" section. Leave unset to keep this block stacked full-width, same as before this field existed.
